invariants: Physical unit instance identity is distinct from champion/catalog identity.
Board, bench, shop and pool are distinct ownership/availability domains.
Observed empty is distinct from missing, unknown, stale and incompatible.
Shop offers are snapshot-scoped opportunities, not owned unit instances.
Item catalog identity is distinct from physical item-instance identity.
Derived and estimated values retain formula, provenance, validity, quality and source sequence.
Candidate and anchor records are evidence proposals, not commands or confirmed active state.
Collection completeness is explicit; absent or empty arrays never silently imply a complete empty set.
Ordering is semantic and stable, never incidental container iteration or mutable catalog order.
Exact action masks remain separate identity-correlated side inputs; history never overrides legality.
Shadow recommendations, evaluator scores, baseline outputs, executor resolutions and diagnostic Unified Shadow state are not PPO observations or targets.

collection_status.complete: Producer attests all members in the declared scope were observed for this exact source sequence.
collection_status.partial: Some members are known, but completeness is not guaranteed.
collection_status.empty: Complete collection with zero members, explicitly observed.
collection_status.unknown: Producer cannot determine membership or completeness.
collection_status.missing: Collection was not supplied by the source.
collection_status.stale: Collection belongs to an earlier source sequence.
collection_status.incompatible: Schema, catalog or identity is incompatible with the consumer.
collection_status.not_applicable: Collection does not apply in this game state or phase.

entities.identity: unverified: native UnitInstanceFactory generates uuid, but it is deterministic from a seeded RNG, repeats after TFTEngine::reset() when the same seed is reused, and has no match/player namespace; it is not accepted as standalone canonical instance_id
relationships: occupies one owned slot at a source sequence
groups by champion_id only for catalog/upgrade analysis
gaps: Unit.items currently contains catalog strings, not physical item-instance references.
UnitInstanceFactory::create() generates uuid from a seeded mt19937_64; TFTEngine::reset() reconstructs the factory from the same seed, repeating the first generated UUID across episodes.
UUID has no encoded match/player scope and no issued-ID collision registry.
UUID is exposed through diagnostic get_audit_snapshot(), not the PPO observation tensor/rollout.
entities.native_identity_candidate: UnitInstance::uuid (scoped/deterministic; not accepted as standalone canonical identity)

entities.invariant: Grouping/catalog key only; never a physical owned-copy identity.

entities.gap: Native 28-slot array index and occupied/empty state are observed; canonical hex coordinates/orientation/adjacency and typed source-sequence correlation remain unverified.

entities.invariant: Preserve stable native slot order; do not compact empty slots.
Offer is not an owned unit instance or pool copy.
gaps: No explicit offer_id, offer revision or reroll-generation token is produced.
Offer UUID is the temporary UnitInstance UUID, not a separate stable offer identity.
Cost is read from champion catalog; no separately versioned offer price field is emitted.
Diagnostic snapshot exposes offer contents, but PPO tensor has no typed offer identity/revision/source-sequence envelope.

entities.invariant: Never infer pool count from local board, bench or shop.

entities.identity: no physical item-instance identity; only item catalog ID strings stored in inventory/equipment containers
gaps: ItemEngine inventory stores std::string catalog IDs; no physical item-instance record or ID exists.
Equipped items are catalog IDs keyed by unit UUID; UnitInstance::items mirrors combat item catalog/API names, not item-instance references.
AuditSnapshot exposes catalog IDs only; no item-instance identity or typed item-owner relationship.
PPO receives numeric semantic rows and heuristic compatibility values, not raw item IDs, item-instance IDs, provenance or typed source sequence.

delivery.diagnostic: get_audit_snapshot exposes inventory catalog IDs and nested unit attachment catalog IDs; no item-instance ID
delivery.ppo: build_observations emits catalog-derived inventory semantic rows, equipped counts and heuristic fit features; no physical item ID or typed owner relation

entities.invariant: Catalog ID plus catalog fingerprint identifies a definition only; it never identifies a physical item copy.
Current count is an aggregate, not a list of physical component instances.
gaps: Repeated component catalog IDs in the vector preserve multiplicity but do not create independently identified physical component instances.
PPO observation emits one count per catalog component, normalized as clamp(count / 6, 0, 1); the current representation loses exact counts above the saturation ceiling.
Catalog order determines numeric feature positions and must be bound to the component catalog fingerprint/order.
The internal PvE component pool remaining count is loot-generation state, not player-owned component-instance identity or shared champion-pool availability.

entities.identity: option_index scoped to a pending ItemAnvil queue entry; no stable option_id or anvil identity is produced
gaps: ItemEngine can enqueue options through grant_component_anvil/grant_completed_item_anvil, but no caller was found in the audited TftEngine gameplay reward path.
The audited PvE reward path grants components and completed items directly; it does not create pending anvils.
The queue stores only kind and catalog-ID strings; there is no anvil ID, stable option_id, revision, producer event ID or source sequence.
The current consumer chooses by positional index and reuses the existing item action/mask head; a target-head sentinel is not a target entity.
The PPO anvil feature computes one best_fit maximum across all unit profiles (and recipe items for components), not per-target target_fits records.
Option-set completeness and pending-decision provenance are not produced.

entities.invariant: Observed unit trait membership differs from active count, completed trait, core trait and strategic focus.

gaps: Position map has no explicit coordinate, orientation, row/column/front-back contract.

entities.invariant: is_core, board_contribution, composition_fit and item_fit are derived/estimated, not observed unit facts.
Evidence proposal only; not an active composition, accepted pivot or command.
Child sell_value/affordability does not prove a complete parent candidate set exists.
Descriptive context only; never a mask or legality override.
Critic-only candidate per consumer matrix; never an Actor legality rule.

temporal_rules: Every snapshot entity collection binds to exact observation snapshot sequence and match/player identity.
Decision-local history binds to exact decision sequence and episode; reset at declared episode boundary.
Shop offer identity expires when shop snapshot or reroll generation changes.
Unit instance identity persists across slot movement but not sale, elimination or new match.
Stale/cross-sequence records are rejected or marked stale; no latest-value fallback.
Partial collections preserve known records and explicit incompleteness; never treat as complete.
unresolved_schema_gaps: Shop has no explicit offer_id, offer revision/reroll generation or observed price field.
Inventory and unit attachments lack physical item_instance_id and explicit attachment owner references.
Pool availability has no authoritative producer or schema field.
Board slot index lacks documented coordinate/orientation mapping.
Positioning and trait aggregates use open maps without complete typed key/catalog contracts.
Unit assessments and anchor candidates need explicit collection completeness and source-sequence contracts.
Action-opportunity producer is not populated; candidate rows remain withheld.

Physical unit UUID producer exists, but same-seed Engine reset repeats the first UUID; no match/player namespace or collision registry exists, so Schema v2 instance_id remains unverified as canonical identity.
Board slot indices and occupancy are native; canonical hex coordinate/orientation/adjacency mapping and exact source-sequence correlation are not proven.
Shop offer contents are produced in five slots, but no stable offer_id, offer revision or reroll-generation token is emitted; slot and temporary unit UUID are not sufficient offer identity.
Physical item copies are not produced: ItemEngine stores catalog ID strings in inventory/equipment containers and has no item_instance_id or typed owner relation.
Component copies are represented by repeated catalog IDs and aggregate counts only; no physical component-instance identity exists, and PPO count normalization saturates at count 6.
Anvil API/consumer exists, but no producer call was found in the audited TftEngine gameplay reward path; normal PvE rewards grant components/completed items directly.
Anvil option identity is positional only; no anvil ID, option_id, revision, completeness or source sequence is produced.
Anvil target fit is emitted as one heuristic best-fit maximum per option, not target-specific target_fits records.
validation_requirements: Every structured schema path maps to an entity kind or explicit aggregate/gap.
Every entity has identity, scope, ownership domain and source-sequence semantics.
No champion/catalog key is used as physical instance identity.
Empty, missing, unknown, partial, stale, incompatible and not-applicable are distinguishable.
Every derived/estimated field retains formula/provenance/quality requirements.
Every temporal collection has reset and stale rules.
All schema gaps are explicit and require versioned review before runtime use.
Board and bench slot indices are kept separate from physical unit identity; empty slots remain explicit and positional.
Shop offer identity is distinct from champion catalog identity, temporary UnitInstance UUID and mutable slot index; offer revision/source sequence is explicit before use.
